data.description:
## Summary
During an MCP tool exercise session (2026-08-27), `archive_ticket` and then `compact_ticket` on a scratch ticket (`synthetic-pygmy-ferret` / `84e6-0fda-265d-4b84`) both returned `result: "ok"` (the local ticket-store write succeeded) but `push_status.state: "pending"` with `reason: "final-push-rejected"`.

## Observed behavior
- `archive_ticket` push attempt: `[rejected] HEAD -> tickets (fetch first)` against `origin/tickets`, `unpushed: "9"`.
- Immediately after, `compact_ticket` push attempt: `[rejected] HEAD -> tickets (non-fast-forward)` against `origin/tickets`, `unpushed: "30"` (grew from 9 to 30 between the two calls, suggesting either concurrent writers on the `tickets` branch or that automatic push-retry/rebase isn't reconciling the local `tickets` ref with `origin/tickets` before each write's push attempt).
- No tool-level error was raised — both calls returned `ok` for the ticket mutation itself, so a caller not inspecting `push_status` would not notice the store is silently falling behind the remote `tickets` branch.

## Why this matters
Per project policy (AGENTS.md / docs/concurrency.md), ticket writes are supposed to auto-commit and auto-push immediately so the store is durable and shared. A silently growing backlog of unpushed local commits (9 -> 30 within ~70 seconds) on the `tickets` branch means:
1. Other agents/sessions may be working from a stale remote view of the tracker.
2. If this local checkout is lost/discarded before the backlog is ever pushed, ticket history is lost.
3. The failure reason differs between the two calls ("fetch first" vs "non-fast-forward"), suggesting the retry logic may not be doing a fetch+rebase/merge before reattempting the push, or is racing another writer without back-off.

## Suspected root cause (needs investigation)
Either:
- Concurrent agents/sessions pushing to `origin/tickets` at the same time as this session, with no automatic fetch+rebase-and-retry after a rejected push, or
- A bug in the push-retry path where after a rejection it keeps committing locally instead of first reconciling with the remote ref.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Root-cause the `final-push-rejected` sequence observed in this session (reproduce or explain via code inspection of the push-status/retry path).
- [ ] Confirm whether the auto-push path performs a fetch + rebase/ff-merge retry loop, and if not, add one (respecting the "no ad-hoc raw git in the tickets tracker" rule — the fix must live in rebar's own push logic, not a manual `git pull`).
- [ ] Ensure a caller can reliably detect and act on a persistently `pending` push_status (e.g. surfaced prominently, or an existing `tracker-maintenance` path recovers it) rather than silently accumulating unpushed commits.
- [ ] Add/extend a test covering the reject-then-retry push path.

## Evidence
- Session: MCP tool exercise of the rebar MCP server against this checkout (rebar itself), 2026-08-27.
- Tickets involved: `southbound-tsunamic-arrowworm` (archived) and `synthetic-pygmy-ferret` (compacted), both scratch test tickets safe to reference/archive.
data.title: Ticket-tracker auto-push falls behind origin/tickets with no fetch+retry, silently growing an unpushed backlog
